note: Heli-Harness v2 narration. start/slot are provisional; the timeline is fitted to the measured takes.

lines.text: [casual] You start a fix in Claude Code. Two tries, no luck. Next morning you open Codex... and it’s starting from zero.
[confident] Heli-Harness keeps a work record for the task: what changed, what failed, and the next smallest step.
So when Codex starts, it gets that record, first thing. Same in Grok Build, OpenCode, Kimi. Switch tools, keep the thread.
[matter-of-fact] And it won’t let agents guess. Check the claim before you fix it. Two failed fixes? Stop and diagnose. Codex tries a third patch anyway... and the hook says no.
Same with “done.” No passing check, no complete. Record the run, and now it closes.
Underneath, one rulebook for every agent. A push waits for your grant, and some commands never run at all.
[warm, confident] Heli-Harness. Switch tools, keep the thread.
